limitations_and_boundaries: The study focuses on mouse embryonic stem cells and may not directly translate to human systems.
The TLS model lacks proper morphogenesis in gastruloids without matrigel embedding.
The effect of CHIR and LDN on NMP reduction and neural disorganization may limit the utility of those conditions for studying balanced lineage differentiation.
The reproducibility assessment was based on a limited panel of 41 genes and nine structures.
The study does not provide long-term culture or functional assessment of the generated structures.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
